thread:
morgan_pm: Quick sync for PredictEmbed GA: final SLA numbers, what goes on the public page vs internal, pricing bands, oncall coverage, and monitoring alerts. Who takes each? :wave:

arun_engineering: I'll own SLA + alerts. Proposed SLOs: p50 < 55ms, p95 < 190ms, error-rate < 0.09%. Ops alerts: p95 > 230ms for 10m, error-rate > 0.18% for 5m, synthetic-checks failing 3/5 -> page. Fallback to smaller model at p95>420ms.

kelly_finance: Pricing suggestion: 14-day trial with 15k tokens/day, then tiers: up to 1M @ $0.00075/token, 1M-5M @ $0.00055, >5M negotiate. Committed discount 20%. Need infra cost-per-token to finalize.

mona_docs: Docs checklist: public quickstart (Python/JS), SLA summary (targets + measurement windows), migration notes for quantized models, troubleshooting runbook, and feature-flag doc for exact-model opt-out. I'll draft primitives; need Grafana snippets and sample error payloads.

eugene_releases: Rollout plan: weekday canary only — 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 10 days. Automated smoke tests gating each step. I'll own automation and rollback policies.

ops-bot: Reminder: default oncall rotation: ml-inference for 21 days post-GA; secondary: backend-sre for 30 days. Rota update scheduled at 6133335000.

morgan_pm: Decisions: 1) Lock SLA numbers? 2) Public SLO vs full SLA doc? 3) Default for quantized fallback?

arun_engineering: Locking above SLOs. Public-facing SLO summary only; enterprise SLA with credits will be separate. Default: allow quantized fallback; opt-out header X-Prefer-Exact: true.

mona_docs: I'll include the Grafana queries and sample errors in the SLA summary. Arun, can you add the example error payloads?

arun_engineering: Sample errors: `{ "error":"rate_limit", "retry_after": 30 }`, `{ "warning":"model_fallback", "note":"reduced-dim vectors" }`. Grafana snippets: `SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95) FROM request_metrics WHERE model='predict-embed-v1'` and `SELECT sum(errors)/sum(requests) FROM request_metrics WHERE model='predict-embed-v1'`.

kelly_finance: Action items for finance: provisional price sheet by EOD + draft committed discount language.

eugene_releases: I'll deliver canary automation + smoke tests in 4 days.

mona_docs: Docs PR and SLA summary in 48h.

arun_engineering: Alerts + runbook in 24h.

morgan_pm: Great. I'll log these into the GA checklist. If no objections, we'll lock SLOs and rollout cadence tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:

kelly_finance: No objections.

ops-bot: Reminder set for rota verification at 6133335000.

morgan_pm: Thanks everyone — follow-ups on the checklist card.
